summary.text: Bethany Ballard was elected to the Georgia House of Representatives in 2022 and represents District 147.

paragraphs.text: She has lived in the district since 2011, when her husband was transferred to Air Force Reserve Command Headquarters.

She holds a BA in English Literature from the University of North Carolina and an MA in English Literature from the University of Central Arkansas, taught high school English, and later ran a small political consulting company.
